- [Costa Rica’s Tamarindo & Las Baulas National Park Highlights](https://travelmemo.com/costa-rica/tamarindo-las-baulas-national-park.md): Tamarindo is alive: surfers, bars, sunsets. And right next door, it goes quiet. In Las Baulas National Park, still mangrove channels wait instead of waves.
- [Nauyaca Waterfalls: Gravel, Jungle and a Natural Pool](https://travelmemo.com/costa-rica/nauyaca-waterfalls-costa-rica.md): The Nauyaca Waterfalls are a highlight of Costa Rica’s Pacific coast. Our advice: pick the farther entrance, then take in the upper waterfall first and finish at the lower one with its natural pool.
